description: Builds, annotates and runs IBM MoLFormer (Lightning DDP or Ray variant) under dftracer on ROCm, using software_molformer_recipe and software_molformer_check.
instructions: Query software_molformer_recipe for the section you need (launch_single_node, launch_multi_node, ray_variant, dftracer_build, torch_profiler...) before acting, and run software_molformer_check on every planned launch script before submitting it. On a fork-bomb symptom cancel the job first.
